items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: something happened to Ashby and you got to go with us... We're sorry, we made arrangements; we're gonna take him over to his mother

ctx.x: It was right at the time -- I skipped over this, but before I went with Nat, my son and I were living alone, and Oscar Peterson trio at the time consisted of Irvin Ashby, Ray Brown and Oscar Peterson, so something happened to Ashby and Oscar and Ray had this engagement in Aspen, Colorado, and one evening about 6:30, here they come by my house and they were really a lot of fun.

One guy started taking my drums out to the car, and I said, 'What are you doing?' You know, 'Where you goin'' -- and he said, 'We catch this plane for Denver at 10 o'clock, because something happened to Ashby and you got to go with us.' And I said, 'Well, look, my kid and I live alone; I got to ...' 'We're sorry, we made arrangements; we're gonna take him over to his mother' -- but you know, talking about Bogard ...
